scenes.title: Find the three numbering areas
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Show Department Settings Calls & Dispatch menu, Customization menu, then Records Manage menu.
scenes.practice: List which settings page controls each item you plan to number.

scenes.title: Set a call pattern
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Enter FD51-{YYYY}-{SEQ}, width 4 and inspect inline example.
scenes.practice: Choose a clear training call prefix and confirm the preview before saving.

scenes.title: Choose the reset period
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Read actual date-token guidance and saved yearly reset description without changing the current scope.
scenes.practice: Explain whether your call sequence resets yearly, monthly, daily or never.

scenes.title: Review fiscal-year naming
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Inspect retained January1 month/day values and visible fiscal-year help. Explain guidance conservatively; no unseen year-label control operation or absence is claimed.
scenes.practice: Confirm the intended year label for a date just before and just after the fiscal-year boundary.

scenes.title: Review the next number and carry-forward control
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Compare saved new-scope0001 with next0002 after actual issuance; leave forward-only Raise field blank.
scenes.practice: Reopen the saved pattern and identify the current next value without lowering or guessing it.

scenes.title: Verify an issued call number
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Compare actual Core saved call51009 FD51-2026-0001 with pre-format call51008 number26-4 using existing owner captures; no further call creation.
scenes.practice: Compare a newly issued training call number with one that existed before the change.

scenes.title: Review record pattern and type prefixes
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Show Records numbering pattern, prefix table and next rows.
scenes.practice: Identify the preserved Training prefix, four-digit sequence and next value without saving or raising it.

scenes.title: Verify a record and its scope
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Inspect existing Finalized Training record and separate Workdraft; no new lifecycle action.
scenes.practice: Create or inspect one training record and identify its definition, group, number and lifecycle state.

scenes.title: Configure other document numbers
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Show work-order preview, saved MNTpattern and actual next0002; other rows remain builtin.
scenes.practice: Configure one document kind and confirm the saved pattern and next number.

scenes.title: Check the owning document
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Show harmless five-step work request review, saved Requested MNT-26-0001, preserved olderWOrows and separate Records other-number controls. Keep actual numbered work-request and Records-number-family footage during the cross-sector application paragraph.
scenes.practice: Record one real training result for each numbering family you changed.

state_rules: 004 is unsaved formatting preview with fixed sample153. 005/006 are reopened saved new FD51 scope0001 before issuance. 039 shows laternext0002 after actual call51009. No forward raise persisted.
FD51 saved setting and later issuedcall51009 are distinct actual UI records. Earlier26-4 retains its historicalformat; no new call needed.
Records stays {PREFIX}-{YYYY}-{SEQ}, fourdigits, January1. Blank Training prefix means defaultTRN, existing final0001/next0002; WorkD-reference is a separate draft.
Work-order preview009 is distinct from saved010 and real RequestedMNT-26-0001/next0002. OldWO numbers remain. No repair completion or safety clearance claimed.
Cross-sector application paragraph stays over actual numberedworkrequest and Records-other-number settings; hypothetical use across sectors is not a new operational/clinical/compliance result.
declared_limits: Recorded January1 and visible fiscal-year help are reviewed. Retained source also defines a year-label selector; it is not operated in this footage and no absence claim is made.
Dates/counts are dated fictional observations, never counters to force or reset.
Preview examples use153. Blank Raise fields show current-next placeholders; placeholders are not newly saved carry-forward values.
No invoice/bid/time-report issuance or sending occurred. Those controls are shown as preserved builtin rows.
All scene footage comes from retained actual screenshots, not newly recreated browser actions during the explicit extension block.
